turns.text: And then they'll ask you these questions.
turns.zh: 然后他们会问你这些问题。

turns.text: Could you tell me your full name, please?
Can you tell me where you're from?
turns.zh: 能告诉我你来自哪里吗？

turns.text: Can I please see your identification?
turns.zh: 能给我看一下你的身份证件吗？

turns.text: Now this part of the test is not assessed.
turns.zh: 现在这部分考试不计分。
